g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 Session 涓� Device State锛歄PEN銆乤ctivity銆丆LOSED 涓� inactivity
Protocol success confirms Queue production only.
Core consumption and state persistence happen later.
State save is asynchronous. Its callback only logs.
No transaction spans Actor state, state keys and Rule Engine event.
[telemetry, attributes, RPC, PING or other accepted uplink]
[reportedTime is newer and state was inactive]
[reportedTime is newer and state already active]
Activity status waits for its own timeout.
Timeout does not cancel a Core Queue record or continuing Actor work.
A late notification is ignored because the listener is gone.
AppActor broadcasts SessionTimeoutCheckMsg every report period
It does not call onDeviceDisconnect and does not write lastDisconnectTime.
[not already alarmed for this activity window]
Transport restart always loses protocol listeners and activity states.
Core restart skips restore for default Caffeine cache.
Redis can restore Actor ASYNC metadata, not the network connection.
